title: プロジェクトデザイン特別科目（３Ｄプリンティング入門）（夏期集中講義）
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal: In this course, students learn from the creation of solutions to prototyping for a given theme based on the knowledge and skills related to subjects the Project Design (PD). On the creation of solutions, students grasp characteristics of the problem qualitatively and aim to acquire relevant skills through ICT utilized trials. Throughout this course, students deepen their understanding of Problem-Based Learning (PBL) by prototyping to assume implementation.
advice:
In this course, to solve a problem using PBL-related methods, students prototype and confirm the effectiveness of proposed solutions. In courses of PD, data handling skills and processes of solving problems based on data science (hypothesis → current situation survey → needs survey → existing measures and remaining problems → cause analysis → solutions creation → report) are required for students. Utilizing this knowledge and skills, prototypes will be created in this course to further materialize solutions. Students will also visit an exhibition at the Igarashi Takenobu Archives and attempt to propose solutions inspired by the works.

Main contents of the course
・Acquire basic skills necessary for 3D modeling
Learn about Tinkercad from its introduction to basic operations. After learning applied operations such as arranging shapes, transforming, and grouping, a model will be created.
・Prototype using a 3D printer
Learn the basic operation of a 3D printer and how to prototype and acquire basic skills in "manufacturing."
・Creating solutions that utilize ICT
Attempt to introduce ICT, such as generative AI and augmented reality (AR), in the creation of solutions.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and skills about PBL acquired in courses of PD.

Utilizing this knowledge and skills, prototypes will be created in this course to further materialize solutions. Students will also visit an exhibition at the Igarashi Takenobu Archives and attempt to propose solutions inspired by the works.

Main contents of the course
・Acquire basic skills necessary for 3D modeling
Learn about Tinkercad from its introduction to basic operations. After learning applied operations such as arranging shapes, transforming, and grouping, a model will be created.
・Prototype using a 3D printer
Learn the basic operation of a 3D printer and how to prototype and acquire basic skills in "manufacturing."
・Creating solutions that utilize ICT
